swarms.name: Cache Invalidation Hooks
swarms.description: Implement data-change-driven cache invalidation for ephemeris file updates, ensuring stale astronomical data is purged from L1 (in-memory), L2 (Redis), and L3 (disk) cache layers

tasks.title: Define ephemeris cache key namespace and invalidation scope
tasks.deliverable: Documentation and code constants defining which CacheKey patterns (e.g., panchanga:*, vimshottari:*, transits:*) are ephemeris-dependent and must be invalidated when ephemeris data changes
tasks.acceptance: A Rust const or enum in noesis-cache lists all ephemeris-dependent cache key prefixes
tasks.validation: Unit test verifies the ephemeris-dependent key list matches actual engine cache key patterns

tasks.title: Add invalidate_by_prefix method to CacheManager for batch invalidation
tasks.deliverable: New method CacheManager::invalidate_by_prefix(&self, prefix: &str) that clears matching keys from L1 (moka scan), L2 (Redis SCAN+DEL), and L3 (disk glob delete)
tasks.acceptance: Method clears all keys matching prefix from all three cache layers and returns count of invalidated entries
tasks.validation: Integration test stores 10 keys with prefix 'panchanga:', calls invalidate_by_prefix('panchanga:'), confirms all 10 are gone from all layers

tasks.title: Add ephemeris file checksum tracking in AppState
tasks.deliverable: On startup, compute SHA256 checksums of ephemeris files in data/ephemeris/ and store in AppState; expose GET /api/v1/admin/ephemeris/checksums endpoint for comparison
tasks.acceptance: Endpoint returns JSON map of filename to SHA256 checksum for all .se1 files in the ephemeris directory
tasks.validation: Changing an ephemeris file and restarting shows different checksum in API response

tasks.title: Add admin endpoint to trigger ephemeris cache invalidation
tasks.deliverable: POST /api/v1/admin/cache/invalidate-ephemeris endpoint (admin-only JWT) that calls invalidate_by_prefix for all ephemeris-dependent key namespaces and returns invalidation summary
tasks.acceptance: Endpoint returns 200 with JSON summary showing count of invalidated keys per cache layer
tasks.validation: Integration test populates cache, calls invalidation endpoint, verifies cache is empty for ephemeris keys but non-ephemeris keys survive

tasks.title: Add file-watcher hook for automatic ephemeris invalidation in dev mode
tasks.deliverable: Optional file watcher (enabled via EPHEMERIS_WATCH=true env var) using notify crate that monitors data/ephemeris/ for changes and auto-triggers cache invalidation
tasks.acceptance: When EPHEMERIS_WATCH=true, modifying an ephemeris file triggers automatic cache invalidation within 5 seconds
tasks.validation: Integration test with watcher enabled: write to ephemeris file, wait 5s, verify cache keys are cleared

tasks.title: Add Sentry breadcrumb for cache invalidation events
tasks.deliverable: Sentry breadcrumb added to every cache invalidation call, recording the invalidation scope (prefix), layer (L1/L2/L3), and count of cleared keys for incident correlation
tasks.acceptance: Cache invalidation triggers appear as Sentry breadcrumbs in the transaction timeline
tasks.validation: Manual test: trigger invalidation, verify breadcrumb appears in Sentry event stream

tasks.title: Add Prometheus counter for cache invalidation events
tasks.deliverable: New Prometheus counter noesis_cache_invalidations_total with labels {trigger, scope} in noesis-metrics, incremented on every invalidation call
tasks.acceptance: /metrics endpoint shows noesis_cache_invalidations_total counter incrementing after invalidation
tasks.validation: Call invalidation endpoint 3 times, verify /metrics shows count=3
